configurations.name: app-revision
runtimeArgs: import os, http.server as h; B = h.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler; H = type('H', (B,), {'end_headers': lambda self: (self.send_header('Cache-Control', 'no-store'), B.end_headers(self))}); h.ThreadingHTTPServer.allow_reuse_address = True; h.ThreadingHTTPServer(('127.0.0.1', int(os.environ.get('PORT', '8130'))), H).serve_forever()
